sites.name: Hung Temple Historic Site
sites.event: A special national relic site, the place of worship for the Hung Kings - the ancestors of the Vietnamese nation, where the annual Hung Temple Festival (Ancestors' Death Anniversary) takes place.

sites.name: Xuan Son National Park
sites.event: The only national park in Vietnam with a primeval forest growing on limestone mountains, famous for its majestic cave system.

sites.name: Au Co Mother Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for Mother Au Co, associated with the legend of the hundred-egg sac and the myth of 'going down to the sea and up to the mountains' of the Vietnamese people.

sites.name: Long Coc Tea Hill
sites.event: Known as the 'Ha Long Bay of the midlands', one of the most beautiful tea hills in Vietnam with hundreds of inverted bowl-shaped tea oases.

sites.name: Lac Long Quan Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for the National Ancestor Lac Long Quan, located within the Hung Temple relic complex.

sites.name: Ao Chau Lagoon
sites.event: A large lagoon likened to the 'inland Ha Long Bay' of Phu Tho, associated with the legend of the Golden Buffalo.

place.commune: Ha Hoa Town, Am Ha Commune, Y Son Commune...

sites.name: Hung Lo Ancient Village
sites.event: An ancient village famous for Hung Lo Communal House (over 300 years old) and the traditional craft of making rice noodles, where ancient Xoan singing is preserved.

sites.name: Lai Len Shrine
sites.event: Considered the birthplace of Phu Tho Xoan Singing (Representative Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity).

sites.name: Thanh Thuy Hot Mineral Spring
sites.event: A natural hot mineral spring containing rare Radon, suitable for relaxation and therapy.

place.commune: La Phu Commune, Bao Yen Commune...

sites.name: Ao Gioi - Suoi Tien
sites.event: A pristine scenic spot with a system of waterfalls cascading from the top of Na Mountain down through rocky tiers.

sites.name: Tam Giang Temple (Chieu Van Vuong Temple)
sites.event: The place of worship for the deity Tho Lenh and Chieu Van Vuong Tran Nhat Duat, located at the river junction (the confluence of the Red River, Lo River, and Da River).

sites.name: May Waterfall
sites.event: A beautiful waterfall located in the middle of a primeval forest, associated with the poetic beauty of the Thanh Son region.
